modmenu.descriptionTranslation.flashback: Exports straight to a folder inside the game directory instead of opening the native file dialog.
flashbackandroidfix.path_hint: Relative to the game folder, or an absolute path. Press Enter to create it.
flashbackandroidfix.forced_tooltip: The export path is forced by the current settings: %s
flashbackandroidfix.interface_tooltip: Drag to set the interface scale (0.25 - 4). The value is only applied after Reload, which also rebuilds the fonts.
